# libXt 1.3.1 — X Toolkit Intrinsics built against em-x11's Xlib.
#
# Upstream autotools are ignored; we compile the .c files directly and
# rely on our hand-written config.h (this dir) and em-x11's public X11
# headers (native/include). No threads, no poll, no real I/O.
#
# SM is enabled (XT_NO_SM is OFF) so libICE + libSM are compiled and
# linked; at runtime SmcOpenConnection fails gracefully and Xt falls
# back to "no session manager".
#
# Warnings are turned down for this third-party tree: upstream Xt has
# its own style (_Xconst, K&R-era casts) that trips -Wall heavy.

set(LIBXT_SRC_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)

set(LIBXT_SOURCES
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/ActionHook.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Alloc.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/ArgList.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Callback.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/ClickTime.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Composite.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Constraint.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Convert.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Converters.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Core.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Create.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Destroy.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Display.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Error.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Event.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/EventUtil.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Functions.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/GCManager.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Geometry.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/GetActKey.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/GetResList.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/GetValues.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/HookObj.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Hooks.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Initialize.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Intrinsic.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Keyboard.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Manage.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/NextEvent.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Object.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/PassivGrab.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Pointer.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Popup.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/PopupCB.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/RectObj.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/ResConfig.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Resources.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Selection.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/SetSens.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/SetValues.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/SetWMCW.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Shell.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/StringDefs.c    # generated by util/makestrs; defines XtStrings[]
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/TMaction.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/TMgrab.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/TMkey.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/TMparse.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/TMprint.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/TMstate.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Threads.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/VarCreate.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/VarGet.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Varargs.c
    ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}/Vendor.c
)

add_library(Xt STATIC ${LIBXT_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(Xt
    PUBLIC  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}                 # config.h
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/X11     # "IntrinsicI.h" quoted includes
            ${LIBXT_SRC_DIR}                            # additional private headers
)

target_compile_definitions(Xt
    PRIVATE HAVE_CONFIG_H=1
            XTHREADS
)

target_compile_options(Xt
    PRIVATE
        -w                          # silence upstream warnings wholesale
        -fvisibility=hidden
)

# Xt needs Xlib and SM/ICE; hooking in em-x11 headers and link targets.
target_link_libraries(Xt PUBLIC X11 SM ICE)

set_target_properties(Xt PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "Xt")
